release_notes:
Release v1.3.0 - 2026-11-19

📚 Documentation:
  • docs: the Costs section names the period of the one Cost Explorer request and that billing validation reads it (review M1), in five languages; zh-Hant from zh-Hans [skip release]
  • docs: the final patch in five languages: one Cost Explorer request per account, --account-services limits the scan, units not read and the InvenTag version in snapshots, fixed order and in-part reasons in the change report, network counts for RDS clusters, MSK and EKS, public subnets by split default routes, the process ends after an abandoned account, MFA without a terminal and other-partition regions in troubleshooting, validation follows --cross-account-role; status items that the patch fixes removed; template field reference regenerated; zh-Hant from zh-Hans [skip release]
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.2.2 [skip release]

♻️ Code Refactoring:
  • refactor: the CLI's start-up check for an MFA profile without a terminal uses the generator's one rule (two copies of the same check became one; behaviour identical, tests untouched)
  • refactor: the generator always passes account_sessions to the processor, discovery always uses the daemon pool, and the account ID hand-over needs no method check; the feature checks for a branch without the other side are gone (behaviour identical, tests untouched)
  • refactor: D-09: the invalid-template exit uses EXIT_ERROR from exit_codes.py; the duplicate constant is gone

✅ Tests:
  • tests: the billing log-line test compares the set of captured lines (a handler left by an earlier test can capture a record twice) [skip release]
  • tests: the VPC enrichment test accepts the shared retry config on the converter's EC2 client (fix3/track-f, A-73)
  • tests: the template-system test double of an account context has the credentials' services and tags lists, as a real AccountCredentials does
  • tests: the docs claims follow the final patch: one Cost Explorer request per account (decision 17), no untagged resources added after a tagging-only run (decision 6), and --validate-credentials checks another account through the cross-account role (A-39), so its failing case denies AssumeRole [skip release]
  • tests: claim T31 follows decision 15: services in a config template limit the scan, so no other service is listed [skip release]
  • tests: the cross-track pairs of the final patch run with both sides on the branch (units_not_read written and read, service limit and change report, one Cost Explorer request under the short limit, EKS row from discovery counted by the analyzer, one client factory)
  • tests: the pricing-cache test no longer sets the removed retry delay [skip release]
  • tests: the listing-pool test does not read discovery's ThreadPoolExecutor name, which it never used
  • tests: drop the A-71 test of a processor without account_sessions; the processor on this branch takes it
  • tests: the D5 column test is no longer xfail (the writers skip the field), the EKS upgrade pair test always runs (lead B's rule is on the branch), and the test of discovery's fallback pool without inventag.core.daemon_pool goes with that fallback
  • tests/regression: row B10 moves the target into current: the process ends within 12 s of the summary (A-25, daemon account and listing workers)
  • tests/regression: rows F1, F2 and F4 pin the empty-result message that names the service filter (A-20); exit codes unchanged
  • tests: the all-denied run's next change report adds nothing: the snapshot names the listings it did not read (decision 6; v1.2.2 pinned the untagged resources as added)
